minutes.headline: Parks Commission backed the Board of Health's Marshall Park septic repair work and asked DPW for a plan on pond and beach weeds.
minutes.summary: The commission heard skate park fundraising and site updates, reviewed a long Marshall Park master plan RFP it thinks is too broad for its budget, and discussed the septic repair process with a site engineer. It voted to support the Board of Health's soil and engineering proposal, to request a DPW plan on aquatic weeds by October 27, and to accept a donated picnic table. Dog policy revisions, the Fitzgerald Field custody change and next agenda items were discussed.

Request the DPW come up with a plan and timeline to address native and non-native plants at Marshall Pond and town beach water by the October 27, 2021 meeting
Accept the donated picnic table as a gift (select board makes final acceptance)

what_happened.line: The Parks Commission voted to support the Board of Health's proposal for soil testing and engineering design to repair the Marshall Park septic system.
It voted to ask the DPW for a plan and timeline on native and non-native plants at Marshall Pond and the town beach by the October 27 meeting.
The commission voted to accept a donated picnic table as a gift; the select board makes the final acceptance.
The chair will trim the Marshall Park master plan RFP to roughly two tasks and fix inaccuracies, because members thought it went beyond the available design money.
Dog regulations were sent back for review pending who enforces them, and skate park size and location will be a listed item at the next meeting.

why_it_matters: The Marshall Park septic repair would be paid in part from an unused Board of Health account, so how far that money goes decides how much of the work falls to the town budget, mostly taxes.
The master plan RFP is limited by the design money available, so what it covers at the town's main pond and beach park depends on how far the chair narrows it.
The weed plan request and the dog regulation review touch beach and pond conditions and how dog rules are enforced, and both are still open.
watch_next: The DPW's plan and timeline on pond and beach weeds, requested for the October 27, 2021 meeting.
The next meeting on September 29 at seven o'clock: the revised Marshall Park RFP and skate park size and location.
